subsystem_chassis_matte_asa.structural_purpose: Tapered protective exoskeleton shell. Employs uniform thermal management parameters to prevent internal print warping and boundary splitting across sharp outer profiles.

subsystem_core_conductive_cf_petg.structural_purpose: Washable electrostatic core mesh matrix. Bypasses standard internal infills to rely entirely on parametric 45-degree supportless alveolar geometry. Slower print speeds maximize long-chain carbon paths for uniform, edge-to-edge electricity distribution.
